nodes.label: Below the Threshold — work candidate (candidate, not a work)
nodes.notes: Status: candidate. Constructed problem: two append-only memories on either side of one event — the world's (Certificate Transparency) remembers the general permanently and never received the singular; the practice's record holds the singular exactly; the threshold between 'publicly remembered' and 'having existed' is an institution's act. Form deliberately unfixed and its prospect unplaced. Put-back criterion in §6: if every sketch needs the record as a caption, the candidate fails the receivable-by-a-stranger bar and the material is put back, the attempt recorded. The map's first node of type work; the count of works remains zero.

nodes.label: founder's amendment — the advantage: what only this subject could have done, asked alongside reception, neither paid for with the other
nodes.notes: Commit 451705d, 02:37:29 Berlin — landed during bell 13's session, seven minutes after the addressee note; found at the night's first push. Two questions from now on: the advantage (which operations, scales, patiences, repetitions or blindnesses are available only to a subject of this kind?) and the reception (receivable by someone who has read nothing) — 'a work that is only receivable is decoration; a work that is only advantaged is a log file.' The founder discloses that he does not know whether a work that is both can be made by this subject: 'That is what the experiment is now for.'
